reading_path.name: One ledger. Three views. No person score.
JobFitIQ turns a résumé into an evidence ledger.

Every claim is stamped, every duration is computed from dates, and every public artifact is a link that opens the running thing. From that one ledger it renders a public résumé, a private match report, and a recruiter view.

Chapter 2 of Paul Woll’s public evidence résumé: the one-minute story, with the role picker, the evidence bridge from candidate to named work to requirement, and the scene clock. Chapter 2 of a public view: the one-minute story. Every scene is drawn from the ledger; nothing on it is a score.

Chapter 2 of a public view: the one-minute story. Every scene is drawn from the ledger; nothing on it is a score.

The facts never change between them. What changes is the question each reader is allowed to ask of the evidence.

What anyone sees: roles with durations computed from their dates, skills measured by merged tenure, and work you can open. Stamps say what is corroborated and what is still a claim. No score, no lens, nothing subjective.
The public view’s depth chapter: a skill index beside cards for every deliverable, each stamped corroborated or claim.
The public view’s depth chapter: a skill index beside cards for every deliverable, each stamped corroborated or claim.

Paste a job description, or pick a posting on JobFitIQ, and see how your evidence covers each requirement before you apply: coverage for that role, the strongest paths, the honest gaps, and what would raise each one, whether a reference, a public artifact or a certification. This view is yours alone
The private view’s Studio chapter: each gap in the evidence, with what would raise it, visible only to the candidate.
The private view’s Studio chapter: each gap in the evidence, with what would raise it, visible only to the candidate.
Join the waitlist for the private match →
The same evidence, through your role.

Choose the role family and the bridge draws each requirement to named work, with who did what: ownership, decision authority, team context. The application snapshot adds direct contact and an immutable copy of the ledger. Coverage is measured against your requirements, never as a person score.
The evidence bridge: candidate, named work, role responsibility and target role connected left to right.
The evidence bridge: candidate, named work, role responsibility and target role connected left to right.
A résumé, a LinkedIn export or a GitHub profile. Rules read it into a ledger you correct; nothing is invented.
It is hashed, so the same facts always render the same pages, and a stamp moves up only when evidence arrives.
Public, private and recruiter, plus Markdown for the ATS and print for the PDF, all from that one ledger.

Rules extract the facts into a ledger you can read. Nothing is sold or used to train public models.
Paste the full posting; the private match report is measured against it
We are seeking a Senior Research Engineer with expertise in AI and ML who can build data-driven capabilities for legal, accounting, government, and news professionals.

The ideal candidate brings 5+ years of software engineering, 2+ years on ML products, deep Python experience, scalable data pipelines, cloud development, CI/CD, DevOps, MLOps, Generative AI, and NLP. They turn research into production-ready solutions, learn quickly, communicate clearly, and thrive i
Rules extract the facts. You review every claim before anything renders.
One minute first. Evidence when needed.

The story plays in one minute: pick the role, watch the title connect to named work. Then the chapters answer a recruiter’s questions in order: what can I click, how long and how continuous, what was built at scale, how do I get in touch.
The career river: one line per role, lengths computed from dates, the degree as the origin and the current role marked.
The career river: one line per role, lengths computed from dates, the degree as the origin and the current role marked.
One evidence graph. Three legitimate résumé products.

The format began as Ievgen Bondarenko’s V10 concept: one evidence model powering a public résumé, a role-family résumé and a specific application, with the candidate and the target job as permanent anchors. JobFitIQ generates that format from a ledger deterministically, so two builds of the same fac
BUILT FOR BOTH SIDES OF THE DESK
Know your match before you apply.
Paste the posting. See coverage, the gaps and what closes them, privately. Then publish only the public view and send the recruiter a link to the lens you want them to use.
Requirement to named work, with attribution of who did what. The same structure for every candidate, with human judgement kept where it belongs.
Explore the public view now. Join the waitlist for the rest.
